$comment: Font delivery budget + glyph repertoire. `npm run gate:fonts` enforces the ceiling and the repertoire; `npm run fonts:subset` regenerates a webfont from its vendored source. Budget is decimal: 30 KB = 30,000 B (the unit the perf baseline and art bible §8 use).

fonts.repertoire: ASCII printable + Latin-1 letters (DE/EN plus Western-European names) + the editorial punctuation DE/EN copy uses (dashes, quotes, ellipsis, bullets, currency).

excluded.reason: Latin-1 symbols with no editorial use in the register: generic currency, broken bar, spacing diacritics, ordinal indicators, not-sign, soft hyphen, macron, acute, cedilla, superscript 1/ordinal-a, fractions. Fractions are written out ("drei Viertel", not "3/4").
Brevied A, dotless i and the spacing/combining diacritics upstream ships for Vietnamese/Turkish/NFD text. The archive is NFC German and English; no surface produces a decomposed sequence.
Thin space, primes, fraction slash, division slash and the byte-order mark. Not used by copy, CSS or the manifest; the BOM is never a rendered glyph.

fallback.reason: The rarity star in CardFace.svelte. Chivo ships no ★ in any cut, so the browser has always drawn it from the fallback stack; the subsetting does not change that and the deck never asks Chivo for it.

The close cross in CardDialog.svelte (added on main by #80). Chivo ships no U+2715 either — it is drawn from the fallback stack exactly as it was at 33,252 B, and it is a control glyph, not DE/EN copy.

fonts.repertoire: Inherited Google Fonts latin subset; lazy-loaded, no vendored source, not regenerated by this pipeline.
